title: Garmin Run Indonesia 2026 Review: What the 2026 Race Was Like
seo_title: Garmin Run Indonesia 2026 Review: BSD Course, Heat, Cut-offs
meta_description: Garmin Run Indonesia 2026 review: 8,000 runners at ICE BSD, a 4.45am half-marathon start at 26°C and 84% humidity, seven water stations, a 3h30 limit and 1:12:54 winning time.
dek: What Garmin's half marathon, 10 km and 5 km in BSD City were like on 20 September 2026: the suburban course, the humid pre-dawn air, the water stations and cut-offs, how fast the front ran, and the race-weekend logistics.
verdict: Enter if you want a well-run half marathon or 10 km near Jakarta with a generous limit and plenty of water. The 2026 race drew 8,000 runners to ICE BSD, started the half marathon at 4.45am, gave it 3 hours 30 minutes and put seven water stations with medics on the course. The front is quick: 1:12:54 won the men's race and 1:27:50 the women's, and podium places are for Indonesian citizens only. The catch is the humidity. At the start it was already 26°C with a dew point of 23°C, rising to 29°C by 8am. Start conservatively, and plan the race-pack pickup in Jakarta two days before.

sections.heading: The Course: Suburban Boulevards Round ICE BSD
paragraphs: The 2026 race started and finished at the Hall 10 car park of ICE BSD, the convention centre in BSD City, Tangerang [1]; the venue's own listing put the event at its Outdoor Plaza B-C [2]. The organiser measured the courses with Garmin devices at 21.12 km for the half marathon, 10.14 km for the 10 km and 5.04 km for the 5 km, and says it will not accept complaints based on runners' own phones or GPS watches [1].

The route maps on the 2026 race site are still headed 2025 [3]. On the half-marathon map the start is on Jl. BSD Grand Boulevard beside ICE. The course follows that boulevard past 1 km, zigzags through side streets to the far corner of the course at about 5 km, then runs up Jl. BSD Raya Pusat, across Jl. Raya Pagedangan, to 10 km at Jl. BSD Boulevard Utara. The second half is a loop through the streets of Bumi Botanika, past the 15 km marker on Jl. BSD Boulevard Utara and the IPEKA BSD school, before it comes back past Jl. Majorie Ave at 20 km to the finish [3].

The 10 km uses the same roads without the zigzag and the Bumi Botanika loop [3]. Garmin publishes no elevation profile. detikINET's report on the race launch called the BSD course relatively flat and said runners often choose the race to chase a personal best [4].

sections.heading: The Weather: 26°C and Humid Before Dawn
paragraphs: Soekarno-Hatta airport, about 20 km north of ICE BSD, recorded 26°C at 4.30am and 5am on race morning, with a dew point of 23°C, 84% humidity and 2 to 4 knots of wind [5]. It stayed at 26°C until 6.30am. From 7am the airport reported haze, and the temperature rose to 28°C at 7.30am and 29°C, with 75% humidity, at 8am and 8.30am, around the time the half marathon closed [5].

A dew point of 23°C means humid air in which sweat evaporates slowly, so a flat course will feel harder than it looks. A 1:45 half marathoner finished around 6.30am in 26°C air; a runner near the 3 hour 30 limit finished after 8am at 29°C, in haze. The half-marathon map marks one water sprinkler, just before 15 km [3].

sections.heading: Aid Stations, Cut-offs and Start Rules
paragraphs: The half marathon had seven water stations, at 2.7, 5.7, 8.8, 11.81, 14.48, 16.97 and 19 km, each with a medical post; the 10 km had three and the 5 km one [1]. The rules list water, isotonic drink and fruit among the refreshments, without saying which stations carry which [1].

The cut-offs were 3 hours 30 minutes for the half marathon, 2 hours for the 10 km and 1 hour for the 5 km [1], so the half closed at about 8.15am. Runners outside the limit are recorded as DNF and do not get a finisher medal [6]. The start also closes: 10 minutes after the 4.45am half-marathon gun. Late half marathoners could only start with the 10 km at 5.20am, and a 5 km runner who missed their start was counted as a non-starter [1].
The rules ban noise-cancelling earphones and recommend open-ear audio instead. Strollers are allowed in every race, and so are the mobility aids used by disabled runners [1].

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: Garmin put the 2026 field at 8,000 runners, its biggest since the first Indonesian race in 2022 [7]. Podium places and prizes are open only to Indonesian citizens; foreign runners appear in the official results but cannot place [1].

Immanuel Hutasoit won the men's half marathon in 1:12:54, 16 seconds ahead of Sardianus Sanam, with Agus Prayogo a second further back in 1:13:11. Desi Kristiani won the women's race in 1:27:50 from Gladys Fabiola Christanto in 1:28:17 and Anjellika Br Ginting in 1:33:43 [7][8]. The 10 km was won by Iqbal Saputra in 32:06 and Novia Nur Nirwani in 38:57, and the 5 km by Juan Meliala in 15:50 [7].

Both half-marathon winning times were faster than in 2025, when Rikki Simbolon and Hutasoit finished together in 1:14:26 and Marhaendrassiwi D. Palupi won the women's race in 1:32:38 [9]. Garmin has published only the top three in each race for 2026; full results were not on a public page when this was written.
At the other end of the field, Garmin ambassador Anggi Wahyuda, a disabled mountaineer running a first half marathon, finished in 3 hours 10 minutes, about 20 minutes inside the limit [7][10].

sections.heading: Race Weekend Logistics
paragraphs: Race packs were collected on Friday 18 September from 10am to 8pm and Saturday 19 September from 10am to 5pm at Epiwalk mall in the Rasuna Epicentrum complex on Jl. HR Rasuna Said, Jakarta, not at the BSD venue [1][11]. Someone else can collect for you with a signed letter of authority and your confirmation email, up to five packs per person [1].

Entry cost Rp735,000 for the half marathon, Rp519,000 for the 10 km, Rp425,000 for the 5 km and Rp220,000 for the 500 m kids' dash [1]. Entries cannot be refunded, transferred or switched to another distance [1][6]. Every entrant gets a race tee and a finisher medal if inside the limit; 10 km and half-marathon runners also get an e-certificate, and half-marathon finishers a finisher tee [6]. Bags can be left from 3.30am to 10am, and the organiser advises arriving an hour before your start [1][6].

Neither the rules nor the FAQ mention a race shuttle. ICE's own directions put the venue about 35 minutes by car from Soekarno-Hatta airport in normal traffic, and five minutes by the BSD Link shuttle or ride-hailing from Cisauk station on the Rangkasbitung commuter line [2].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a well-organised half marathon or 10 km close to Jakarta, with a 3 hour 30 limit, water about every 3 km and a quick national-level front. It also suits families: strollers are allowed in every race and there is a 500 m kids' dash [1].

Think twice if you want a full marathon, which Garmin says it is not adding yet, for safety reasons [4], or if you race badly in humid air: at the 2026 start it was already 26°C with a dew point of 23°C [5].
The 2027 date, entry fees and route had not been published when this was written. Check the route map when it appears, since the one posted for 2026 was the 2025 version [3].

Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the organiser's rules, FAQ and route maps, Garmin's post-race results, airport weather records, the 2025 results, and Indonesian and English-language press reports.

pull_quotes.quote: I chose Garmin for safety reasons
pull_quotes.attribution: Anggi Wahyuda, Garmin ambassador, on running a first half marathon at the 2026 race, to ObserverID

faqs.question: What time does the Garmin Run Indonesia half marathon start?
faqs.answer: Early. In 2026 the half marathon started at 4.45am, the 10 km at 5.20am, the 5 km at 5.35am and the kids' dash at 7am, all from ICE BSD. The start closes 10 minutes after each gun; late half marathoners had to start with the 10 km. Bag drop opened at 3.30am.

faqs.question: How hot and humid is Garmin Run Indonesia?
faqs.answer: Humid. At the 4.45am start in 2026, Soekarno-Hatta airport, about 20 km away, recorded 26°C, a dew point of 23°C and 84% humidity with little wind. It stayed at 26°C until 6.30am, then rose to 29°C with haze by 8am. Pace for the humidity rather than the flat-looking course.

faqs.question: What is the cut-off time for the Garmin Run Indonesia half marathon?
faqs.answer: Three hours 30 minutes, which put the 2026 finish close at about 8.15am. The 10 km had two hours and the 5 km one hour. Runners outside the limit are recorded as DNF and do not get a finisher medal. Seven water stations, each with a medical post, cover the half-marathon course.

faqs.question: How fast do you need to be to place at Garmin Run Indonesia?
faqs.answer: Fast. In 2026 the men's half marathon was won in 1:12:54, with third place in 1:13:11, and the women's in 1:27:50, with third in 1:33:43. The 10 km was won in 32:06 and 38:57. Podium places and prizes are open only to Indonesian citizens; foreign runners are listed but cannot place.

faqs.question: Where do you collect the Garmin Run Indonesia race pack?
faqs.answer: In Jakarta, not at the BSD venue. In 2026 packs were collected at Epiwalk mall on Jl. HR Rasuna Said on Friday 18 September, 10am to 8pm, and Saturday 19 September, 10am to 5pm. A friend can collect with a signed letter of authority and your confirmation email, up to five packs.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-29 about the 2026 edition, run on 20 September 2026. Replaces a review of the 2025 race. Weather is from Soekarno-Hatta airport METAR observations, about 20 km from the start, not a forecast. Only the top three in each race have been published for 2026; no public full results were found. The route maps posted for 2026 are headed 2025. The rules place the start at the Hall 10 car park; the venue's listing says Outdoor Plaza B-C. No independent runner accounts of the race were found. No rating.
